headline: Oil Prices Drop as Hopes for Middle East Peace Offset Escalation Fears
summary: Crude oil prices fell as emerging hopes for peace negotiations counterbalanced investor worries over expanding conflict across the Middle East.
why: Crude oil is a vital global energy benchmark; geopolitical tensions in the Middle East typically add a supply risk premium to contracts.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Diminished conflict fears reduce the geopolitical risk premium priced into crude futures.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Lower oil prices put pressure on operating margins and cash flows for upstream oil producers.

why_moved: Crude prices slid as optimism regarding diplomatic de-escalation reduced market concerns over potential Middle Eastern supply disruptions.
